# buf.format-check fails with a diff on unformatted files, and buf.format
# rewrites them, after which the check passes.
[!exec:buf] skip

bit check
stdout 'check ▶ buf format --diff --exit-code'
stdout 'check ✔ ok'

cp user.proto.messy proto/acme/v1/user.proto
! bit check
stdout '-     string name = 1;'
stdout '\+  string name = 1;'
stdout 'check ✘ tests failed'
cmp proto/acme/v1/user.proto user.proto.messy

bit fix
stdout 'fix ▶ buf format --write'
stdout 'fix ✔ ok'
cmp proto/acme/v1/user.proto user.proto.formatted

bit fix
stdout 'fix · no changes'

bit check
stdout 'check ✔ ok'

-- BUILD.bit --
explicit check = buf.format-check {}
explicit fix = buf.format {}
-- buf.yaml --
version: v2
modules:
  - path: proto
-- proto/acme/v1/user.proto --
syntax = "proto3";

package acme.v1;

message User {
  string name = 1;
}
-- user.proto.messy --
syntax = "proto3";

package acme.v1;

message User {
     string name = 1;
}
-- user.proto.formatted --
syntax = "proto3";

package acme.v1;

message User {
  string name = 1;
}
